title: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia’s 2020 A100 GPUs Can Stay ‘Mission-Capable’ Through 2029—Here’s Why It Matters for the AI Boom
excerpt: Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang said Wednesday that the company’s older AI chips can remain economically useful for nearly a decade, pushing back...
content_html:
Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang said Wednesday that the company's older AI chips can remain economically useful for nearly a decade, pushing back against concerns that rapid advances in AI could quickly make GPUs obsolete.

Jensen Huang Says A100 GPUs Can Last Nearly a Decade

Huang said on X that Nvidia's A100 fleet is "mission-capable from 2020 through 2029," highlighting the longevity of the company's data center GPUs.

The A100 debuted in 2020 as part of Nvidia's Ampere generation.

"NVIDIA computing is more than chips," Huang said, pointing to the company's CUDA software platform as a key reason its hardware can remain useful across generations.

"CUDA makes NVIDIA computing versatile," he added. "Versatility makes it fungible. Fungibility drives utilization and extends durability."

His comments came after reposting a Business Insider report about the continued demand for the five-year-old A100.

The mighty A100 fleet are mission-capable from 2020 through 2029. NVIDIA computing is more than chips. CUDA gives developers and NVIDIA engineers a common platform to continually upgrade Ampere, Hopper and Blackwell throughout their useful lives.
CUDA makes NVIDIA computing… https://t.co/KQ1kp7Vpae

— Jensen Huang (@JensenHuang) August 13, 2026

Read Also:SharonAI Shares Rally as Nvidia Deal Overshadows a Messy Earnings Quarter

CoreWeave's 2029 A100 Deal Challenges GPU Obsolescence Fears

Huang's comments followed a disclosure from AI cloud provider CoreWeave Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWV) that it signed a contract to rent Nvidia A100 GPUs through 2029 at what CFO Nitin Agrawal described as an "attractive price."

That means the 2020-era chips could still generate revenue nearly nine years after launch, despite several newer Nvidia GPU generations entering the market.

The development challenges a key concern among AI infrastructure bears that accelerating chip improvements could cause older GPUs to lose their economic value within two or three years.

Why GPU Longevity Matters for Nvidia's AI Boom

Older GPUs can remain useful by shifting from the most demanding AI workloads to inference, smaller models and other applications that do not require the latest hardware, the BI report stated.

Rental-market data also supports CoreWeave's assessment. Silicon Data, which tracks GPU rental prices, on Tuesday said A100 rates have remained resilient following a strong rebound in 2026.

As @JensenHuang argued in his essay, we believe that GPUs should be increasingly thought of as financeable capital assets with stable cash flows coming from AI inference.

Based on our residual fair value estimates, A100 stopped depreciating since late 2025 as rising rental… https://t.co/ZLEmwuFnay pic.twitter.com/AsURz1W6lM

— Silicon Data (@Silicon_Data) August 11, 2026

content_html_zh:
英伟达公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）首席执行官黄仁勋周三表示，该公司较旧的人工智能芯片在近十年内仍可在经济上发挥作用，反驳了人工智能的快速发展可能很快使 GPU 过时的担忧。

黄仁勋表示 A100 GPU 可持续使用近十年

黄在 X 上表示，Nvidia 的 A100 机群“能够在 2020 年到 2029 年期间执行任务”，强调了该公司数据中心 GPU 的使用寿命。

A100 于 2020 年首次亮相，作为 Nvidia Ampere 一代的一部分。

黄仁勋表示：“NVIDIA 计算不仅仅是芯片。”他指出，该公司的 CUDA 软件平台是其硬件能够在几代人之间保持有用的关键原因。

“CUDA 使 NVIDIA 计算变得多功能，”他补充道。 “多功能性使其具有可替代性。 可替代性提高了利用率并延长了耐用性。”

他是在转发《商业内幕》(Business Insider) 的一篇有关五年前 A100 持续需求的报道后发表此番言论的。

CoreWeave 的 2029 A100 交易挑战了 GPU 过时的担忧

黄仁勋发表此番言论之前，人工智能云提供商 CoreWeave Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）披露称，该公司签署了一份到 2029 年租用 Nvidia A100 GPU 的合同，首席财务官 Nitin Agrawal 称其价格“颇具吸引力”。

这意味着，尽管有几代较新的 Nvidia GPU 进入市场，2020 时代的芯片在推出近九年后仍可产生收入。

这一发展挑战了人工智能基础设施中的一个主要担忧，即加速芯片改进可能会导致旧 GPU 在两三年内失去其经济价值。

为什么 GPU 寿命对于 Nvidia 的 AI 繁荣很重要

BI 报告指出，通过从最苛刻的人工智能工作负载转向推理、较小的模型和其他不需要最新硬件的应用程序，较旧的 GPU 仍然可以发挥作用。

租赁市场数据也支持 CoreWeave 的评估。 追踪 GPU 租赁价格的 Silicon Data 周二表示，继 2026 年强劲反弹后，A100 租金仍保持弹性。

正如 @JensenHuang 在他的文章中所说，我们认为 GPU 应该被越来越多地视为可融资的资本资产，具有来自人工智能推理的稳定现金流。 根据我们的剩余公允价值估计，随着租金上涨，A100 自 2025 年底以来停止贬值…… https://t.co/ZLEmwuFnay pic.twitter.com/AsURz1W6lM — Silicon Data (@Silicon_Data) 2026 年 8 月 11 日
